agent_notes: The official Regular Courses page contains PG Programme, UG Programme, and Diploma Programme headings but no programme rows; the official Distance Education page likewise contains no programme rows.
The official Prospectus and New Course Started pages contain no programme catalogue entries, so no course names were imported and the catalogue remains incomplete.

The institution page links the former http://www.mpcolleges.nic.in/gdcajaigarh page, but that hostname did not resolve during this run; the current official Higher Education Department institution page was used instead.
Normal TLS verification returned the managed proxy error “self signed certificate in certificate chain”; curl --insecure was then used only for public GETs to confirmed official/search domains.
